授業科目の概要.講義題目: AI, Arts, and Intercultural Skills: Creating the Future of Learning
授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 共創学部/School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 後期集中 その他 その他
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course is jointly conducted with The Education University of Hong Kong (EDUHK). The teaching team consists of faculty members from Kyushu University and EDUHK with expertise in AI, STEM education, arts, and intercultural communication. Students will benefit from learning in an interdisciplinary and international environment guided by the following instructors:
Li Xiaoyan, Professor, School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation, Kyushu University, Japan
Sun Daner, Associate Professor, Department of Mathematics and Information Technology, EDUHK, Hong Kong, China
Pei Leisi, Assistant Professor, Department of Curriculum and Instruction, EDUHK, Hong Kong, China
Singh Manpreet, Lecturer, Department of Mathematics and Information Technology, EDUHK, Hong Kong, China
Yang Yin, Nicole, Research Assistant Professor, Department of Mathematics and Information Technology, EDUHK, Hong Kong, China
Zhang Le-Xuan, Research Assistant Professor, Department of Cultural and Creative Arts, EDUHK, Hong Kong, China

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この科目は、AI、芸術、異文化対応力をテーマに、国際的かつ学際的な学びを通じて未来の教育のあり方を探究することを目的とする。香港教育大学の学生との合同授業を通じ、AIリテラシーや批判的思考、創造性、異文化理解を育成し、国際協働による問題解決や知識創造の実践を経験する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The purpose of this course is to explore the future of education through the integration of AI, arts, and intercultural competence. Conducted jointly with students from The Education University of Hong Kong, the course aims to foster AI literacy, critical thinking, creativity, and intercultural understanding. Students will gain practical experience in international collaboration, problem-solving, and knowledge co-creation in a multicultural and interdisciplinary context.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: AI literacy; arts and creativity; intercultural competence; interdisciplinary learning; global collaboration; problem-solving; knowledge co-creation
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: There are no specific prerequisites for this course. However, as the class will be conducted in English and involve international collaboration, students are expected to actively participate in discussions and group work in English.
